title: Midnight Drive
aesthetic: nocturnal synthwave cruise — groove and motion: a shuffled pocket, filters that breathe open, pads that swell, an arp that drifts across the stereo field
_feature_note: This group is the worked demo for the two expression tools that shape a parameter *over time*: track/section 'swing' for a shuffled pocket, and per-part 'automation' envelopes (ramp or lfo) driving 'filter', 'gain', and 'pan'. Everything else (motif reuse, sections, arp) is here only to give those two tools something to move.
_motifs_note: cruise is a laid-back 8-beat hook built to sit in the shuffle: long tones on the strong beats, a couple of eighths on the off-beats where the swing bites. It states whole in the loop and returns sliced in the outro.
